content: More than a decade after the first film debuted, the franchise remains as relevant as ever, especially as our real world continues to look more and more like the dystopian nation of Panem. In 2023, we got a movie, The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes, exploring the backstory of the franchise’s main villain, President Snow. Francis Lawrence’s Sunrise on the Reaping, his fifth Hunger Games movie, is a direct sequel to that story, and while it’s still YA, he and his team push the boundaries of what we can expect from the genre. The result is an incredibly entertaining blockbuster with the feel of a bleak, existential horror movie.
